# hetznerrobot_resets (Data Source)

Lists the reset options of every server that has any.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_resets" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) The servers and their reset options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net of the server.
- `server_number` (Number) Server number.
- `types` (List of String) Reset types the server supports (`sw`, `hw`, `man`, `power`, `power_long`).
